description:
Check the status of render jobs started by clipform_render_video_template or clipform_render_composition.

Pass job_ids to check a whole batch in ONE call - one line of status per job. Pass job_id for a single job. Returns the output URL for each completed render. Typical render time: 10-60 seconds. Attach is automatic when node_id was provided to the render tool - no need to poll to completion, and the attach outcome is reported here once known.

context.description: Describe the user's underlying goal in one sentence - not the tool you're calling.

job_id.description: A single job ID returned by the render tool

job_ids.description: Multiple job IDs - check the whole batch in one call instead of one call per job

name: clipform_check_render

jobs.description: One entry per queried job; attach completed public_urls via upload_media_asset then attach_node_media unless already auto-attached

attach_error.description: Present when node_id was set but auto-attach failed - the render itself still succeeded.

attached.description: True when the render's node_id was set and it attached to the node automatically.

media_asset_id.description: The workspace media asset created from this render, when attached.

republished.description: True when the form was live and was republished to include this media.

title: Check Render Status
